_why.docs/the-loop.md: The gap map: every arrow of the session loop with what notices it. Its own closing line is that it is a persisted artifact with reader:session and no read trigger — so nothing fires it, and a context that skips it re-derives gaps already enumerated there. This roster is that fix.
_why.docs/answerable-not-felt.md: The design of record for the groove arc. A context that skips it re-opens decisions the note already settled, and its companion research file records that the note's most distinctive claims are unmeasured — which a reader must know before resting on them.
_why.docs/purpose.md: The north-star carrier — what lifecycle is BECOMING, as distinct from what it enforces today. Every other roster file describes a gap or a mechanism, and neither says what the gaps are gaps IN: this one carries the goal (a project with a continuous mind, held outside every head that thinks with it), the creed that divides labour between model and environment (interpretation vs presence/demand/independent feedback), the KILL TEST that makes session-independence measurable, and the named conditions that would falsify the whole design. A session that skips it optimizes the wrong quantity. The roster is the floor, and the floor now includes why the repo exists. Operator direction 2026-09-19: this basis holds anytime work happens in here, not only on design-arc work.

_not_listed_on_purpose.CLAUDE.md: The laws file is already injected by the harness; restating it here would be a second home for one fact.
_not_listed_on_purpose.ITEMS.md / LEDGER.md: Read by verbs, not by a session — item ready, item check, ledger rejected. A kind a command reads needs no roster entry.
_not_listed_on_purpose.docs/audits/: Individually reachable through `kind list --digest`, which names each home and its newest member. A roster that lists everything is one nobody reads; the digest is the index, this roster is the floor.
